inbox.subject: ACM fall formal: RSVP by Friday
inbox.body:
Hi everyone,

The ACM fall formal is Dec 5, 7–11pm, in the Campus Center Auditorium. Dinner is included. Please RSVP by Friday by emailing fallformal-rsvp@umass.edu with your name and any dietary restrictions.

Jordan
ACM Treasurer
